prepared_protocol.settings: Frozen readiness config; cruise0.400, target0.90, minimum_hold0.8, maximum_hold1.0, ramp0.4, physics1ms, control100ms
prepared_protocol.required_reporting: Keep all attempts; arrival/stop, native replay, timestamp/diagnostics coverage, full-route and post-contact slip/vibration/time/tracking, phase-aligned peak/contact/motor context
prepared_protocol.stop: If reporting fails, stop. If quality ranking/large spikes remain inconsistent, stop expanding and review contact/IMU fidelity. If repeated recovery/exit deficit is supported, choose one independently tested correction. No unbounded parameter sweep.

decision_rule: Stop immediately on missing reporting/physical failure; otherwise compare both fixed pairs and stop expansion on inconsistent quality ranking. No score/candidate selection.
comparison: Crossing RMS and whole-route peak rankings are descriptive; no significance or hardware fidelity claim from two repetitions
